easyPrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Sylvan Awakening by paying {2}{G}, causing all lands you control including Grove of the Burnwillows to become 2/2 Elemental creatures with reach, indestructible, and haste until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
